mapper.insert: insert into expert_agent_run (run_id, objective, run_status, model, max_steps, step_count, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{runId}, #{objective}, 'RUNNING', #{model}, #{maxSteps}, 0, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update expert_agent_run set run_status = #{runStatus}, step_count = #{stepCount}, final_answer = #{finalAnswer}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = sysdate() where run_id = #{runId}
mapper.insert: insert into expert_agent_step (run_id, step_no, tool_name, tool_input_json, observation_json, step_status, latency_ms, create_time) values (#{runId}, #{stepNo}, #{toolName}, #{toolInputJson}, #{observationJson}, #{stepStatus}, #{latencyMs}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select run_id runId, objective, run_status runStatus, model, max_steps maxSteps, step_count stepCount, final_answer finalAnswer, error_message errorMessage, create_by createBy, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime from expert_agent_run where run_id = #{runId}

select step_id stepId, run_id runId, step_no stepNo, tool_name toolName, tool_input_json toolInputJson, observation_json observationJson, step_status stepStatus, latency_ms latencyMs, create_time createTime from expert_agent_step where run_id = #{runId} order by step_no, step_id
